Riding Car Model - Toy for Kids - One piece print

🚘 I designed Simple Riding Car Model With Moving Wheels.

🧸 Perfect Toy for kids. Just print it, and it’s immediately ready to play.

Adults too, of course! :)

 

This car model features designed seats and a dashboard inside.

 

🚗 Enjoy the convenience of riding a one-piece print without the hassle of assembly.

You can print cars using any color of filament you desire.

Key features:

✅ No assembly is required.

✅ Perfect toy for kids.

✅ Riding model with moving wheels.

 

⬇️ Also check out other riding models:

🚐 Double decker Bus → https://makerworld.com/en/models/2139021

🚗 Riding car → https://makerworld.com/en/models/1410834

 

⚠️ PETG is recommended because it allows the wheels to move faster and smoother.

 

⚠️ I recommend using Smooth Plate because the model is printing on the side.
